title: Five Women Posing Outside House, 1961 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot from September 1961 capturing five older women posing outside a white clapboard house. Each woman rests her hand on the shoulder of the person in front of her in a playful chain pose. They are dressed in mid-century day dresses and eyeglasses. The background features a covered front porch, white siding, and windows. The right side shows a partial view of a person holding a camera or taking a picture. The photograph has deckled edges and bears a printed date stamp at the bottom border reading 'SEP • 61'.
